definition: every term is a raw displacement in dx. Nothing is normalised by the displacement it measures and no term is rescaled into primary units

historical_comparator.note: the L1A-2y numbers are read from its sealed evidence and are reported as the historical comparator; they are never overwritten and no L1A-2y file is modified

identity_note: R_sequential_telescoping_total is the floating-point residual of an algebraic identity: the sum of the per-operator differences of one observable between consecutive actual states equals the difference between the first and the last state by construction. It is reported as a closure check and it is not evidence of a mechanism
